sec: The 4400 mEq H⁺ requirement and buffering · p822

items.q: For reabsorption of 1 mEq of HCO₃⁻, how much H⁺ is used?
opts: 1 mEq of H⁺
0.5 mEq of H⁺
2 mEq of H⁺
No H⁺ — it is a passive step
items.exp: For 1 mEq HCO₃⁻ reabsorption, 1 mEq of H⁺ is used — the basis of the daily H⁺ requirement. (Book p822)

items.q: Adding the 4330 mEq of filtered HCO₃⁻ to the 80 mEq of non-volatile acid gives a daily requirement of:
opts: 4400 mEq of H⁺
4330 mEq of H⁺
4250 mEq of H⁺
4410 mEq of H⁺
items.exp: 4330 mEq of HCO₃⁻ + 80 mEq of non-volatile acid = 4400 mEq of H⁺ required, which the book calls not practically possible. (Book p822)

items.q: Because 4400 mEq of H⁺ per day is not practically possible, the book concludes:
opts: There is a requirement of the buffering system
The kidney must excrete 4400 mEq of titratable acid
Bicarbonate filtration must fall to 4000 mEq/day
Respiratory compensation alone must handle the load
items.exp: 4400 mEq of H⁺ required (not practically possible) → requirement of buffering system. (Book p822)

items.q: Match the quantities used to reach the daily H⁺ requirement — 1) Filtered HCO₃⁻  2) Non-volatile acid  3) Total H⁺ required … A) 80 mEq  B) 4400 mEq  C) 4330 mEq
items.exp: 4330 mEq of HCO₃⁻ plus 80 mEq of non-volatile acid demands 4400 mEq of H⁺ per day. (Book p822)

items.q: ‘The kidney alone can secrete the 4400 mEq of H⁺ needed each day, without any buffering.’
opts: False — the book calls 4400 mEq of H⁺ not practically possible and invokes buffering
True — tubular secretion covers it entirely
True — because urine HCO₃⁻ excretion is nil
False — because only 80 mEq of H⁺ is needed daily
items.exp: 4400 mEq of H⁺ per day is explicitly labelled ‘not practically possible’, which is why the buffering system is required. (Book p822)

items.q: A student computes daily H⁺ need as 4330 mEq from filtered bicarbonate alone. What has been left out?
opts: The 80 mEq of non-volatile acid, giving 4400 mEq
The 4000 mEq reabsorbed in the thick ascending limb
The 24 mEq/L of urine bicarbonate
The 7 crore nmol excreted as ammonia
items.exp: The 4330 mEq of filtered HCO₃⁻ must be added to the 80 mEq of non-volatile acid, giving the printed total of 4400 mEq of H⁺. (Book p822)
